summary: scripts/review now runs the tests that list every table, index, trigger and view whenever a change adds or drops one, and stops before asking the model if one fails. A new table missing from the canonical audit reached main red (#6957) because hosted CI does not run every crate's tests for each pull request.

replay.detail: Tooling only; nothing runs in the daemon.

compatibility.detail: No wire or API change. scripts/review runs the base's copy of scripts/schema-checks, so a change cannot switch off its own checks. A base without it runs nothing.

manual.detail: Nothing to do. Run scripts/review on the change as before. For a schema change it first runs fractal-seats' canonical audit and smallclaims' schema-install tests, which must pass outright, and the large-value inventory check, which fails only on findings the change adds against its merge base, never on ones main already has. It takes about a minute warm. A cargo test filter that matches no test counts as a failure.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; nothing else depends on it.
